capabilities: check link style for the current note, current folder or whole vault
check the current note's wiki layout against the Numbered-v1 profile
check the current note's activity text against the Numbered-v1 profile
show a capabilities and compatibility panel with pinned engine revisions
navigate to a finding's note location from the findings view
disambiguation: Despite the name, it never modifies the vault; it only reports findings about link style, wiki layout and activity text.
extras: Verified only on macOS arm64 Obsidian desktop 1.15.0; mobile and other platforms are unverified. The manifest states the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. All checks are off by default and no automatic scanning occurs.
intentEvidence: powered by the ViggObsidian Rust engine
problem: Obsidian has no rule-based, read-only validation for link style conventions or specialized wiki and activity note layouts, and users may not want any tool that edits notes.

relations.evidence: Rust engines by Viggo Meesters are vendored unchanged from ViggObsidian at their recorded revisions

summary: Read-only checker that reports wikilink style, wiki layout and activity text findings in a vault, powered by the ViggObsidian Rust engine.
